links.outcome: Diagnostic hit1 of fine-tuned compact model versus flagship and other LLMs on the same test cases
links.effect: Fine-tuning raised Qwen3-8B hit1 from 68.41% to 79.84%, highest among evaluated models; physician-adjudicated Hit1 91.6% versus 93.5% for GPT-5.6 Sol (1000 cases).
links.quote: Fine-tuning increased Qwen3-8B's hit1 from 68.41% to 79.84%, the highest among the evaluated models on the internal test set.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning a compact open-source LLM on institution-specific real-world cases for local deployment
Local deployment of models to keep clinical data within the institution

screen.reason: The study evaluates the diagnostic performance and local deployment feasibility of a fine-tuned compact LLM (Qwen3-8B) on retrospective real-world clinical rheumatology cases, comparing it to flagship closed models, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
